entities.summary: Universidad de las Américas Puebla, commonly known as UDLAP, is a Mexican private university located in San Andrés Cholula, near Puebla. The university is known for its programs in Finance, Arts and Humanities, Social sciences, Science and Engineering, and Business and Economics. It is considered to be one of the most prestigious universities in Latin America, having been ranked the best private and single-campus university in Mexico by the newspaper El Universal, as well as being one of the only seven universities in Latin America accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: UDLAP has been ranked as one of the best private universities in Mexico and Latin America, with a strong focus on programs in Finance, Arts and Humanities, and Business and Economics. Its accreditation by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools demonstrates its commitment to quality education.
